1) Invoice routing: can you confirm whether invoices should go to AP@redwood.com or a dedicated invoice ingestion endpoint? Our accounting team prefers a dedicated email to avoid manual routing delays.

We can provide weekly invoice batches and a sample remittance file.

Attached: VendorOnboarding_Form_BrightLine.xlsx, W-9_BrightLine.pdf

Priya / Marissa / Daniel —

Appreciate the clear ask. A few notes from AP and proposed next steps:

- Ingestion: invoices@redwood-payments.com is the canonical ingestion address. If BrightLine needs a dedicated mailbox, we can create invoices-brightline@redwood-payments.com but it requires a short configuration (1–2 business days) and a routing rule. For go-live, please start with invoices@redwood-payments.com and cc accounts@brightline-analytics.com.

- PO timing: once Marissa confirms the onboarding form and we have a signed SOW/PO trigger, PO issuance typically takes 48 hours. Please include your billing contact and remit address on the vendor form (we've requested this).

- Early-pay program: we run an early-pay pilot via a purchase-order-backed program with fixed weekly settlement windows. To evaluate: we need (a) historical monthly invoice volume and aging, (b) maximum invoice amount you want to include in Net 10, and (c) confirmation you can deliver EDI/CSV remittance files.

Regarding the proposed 12% discount: that is outside our standard early-pay bands. For a pilot, Finance needs to approve a temporary rate and cap exposure per week. I've attached our standard early-pay terms for pilots; please review and return a signed copy if you want us to circulate for Finance approval.

Attachments: EarlyPay_T&Cs_BrightLine.pdf

If BrightLine can supply a 3-month sample of invoices (CSV) and indicate a weekly cap (e.g., $50k/week), we can run a 60-day pilot with weekly settlements and report back on cost/benefit.

-David
David Kim
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
